documentation.content:
FEWER PODS ARE SERVING THAN INTENDED.

Impact: reduced capacity now, and a single further failure could take the service down entirely. At zero available replicas this is a full outage.

First command:
  ./scripts/verify-pods.sh -n orders

Investigation:
  kubectl get pods -n orders -o wide
  kubectl get endpoints orders-api -n orders     <-- zero endpoints = total outage
  kubectl get events -n orders --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -20

Common causes:
  Pending           -> insufficient CPU/memory, taint mismatch  (TROUBLESHOOTING section 1)
  Running but 0/1   -> readiness probe failing                  (TROUBLESHOOTING section 5)
  CrashLoopBackOff  -> application fails at boot                (TROUBLESHOOTING section 3)

If this fired during a deploy, --atomic should have rolled back. Verify:
  helm history orders-api -n orders

conditions.displayName: available replicas below desired for 5 minutes
